args.prompt: The creature is cute, silly and friendly, never scary, in the same chunky pixel style and outline as the cat-unicorn reference sheet. Redraw the FLYING SNAKE from the world reference drawing: a long thin glossy lime-green snake seen from the side, head on the right with a rounded head, two small round eyes and a tiny dot mouth, pink forked tongue, tapered tail on the left, a pale highlight stripe along the body. Draw 8 poses arranged in a grid of 2 rows by 4 columns, equally spaced, plenty of empty space between them. Poses: (1)-(6) a slithering wave cycle, the S-shaped wave travelling from head to tail, six different poses, tongue hidden; (7) tongue flicking out; (8) head tilted down looking down with the tongue out. Each snake is about 40 percent of the image width. 16-bit Super Nintendo style pixel art, chunky hard square pixels, a clean 1-pixel dark plum outline, flat cel shading with one highlight and one shadow tone, light from the top left, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur, no text, no labels, no watermark. Solid flat cyan background, nothing else.
